function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Sure! Here are a few ways you can order a cake, depending on what you’re looking for:

| Option | What it offers | How to order | Tips |
|--------|----------------|--------------|------|
| **Online cake delivery services** | Nationwide delivery, custom designs, same‑day options | Visit sites like **Goldbelly**, **Etsy (hand‑made cakes)**, **Blue Apron (cake kits)**, or local delivery platforms such as **DoorDash** or **Uber Eats** that partner with bakeries. | Check delivery times & shipping fees. Look for reviews or ratings. |
| **Local bakeries** | Fresh, often handmade, personalized flavors | Google “bakery near me” or use apps like **Yelp** or **Google Maps** to find nearby shops. Call or visit their website to place an order. | Ask about custom sizes, dietary restrictions, and pickup vs. delivery. |
| **Specialty cake shops** | Signature cakes, themed designs, premium ingredients | Search for “specialty cake shop” + your city. Many have online ordering portals (e.g., **Cake Boss**, **The Cake Shop**). | Great for birthdays, weddings, or corporate events. |
| **Grocery stores & supermarkets** | Ready‑made cakes, quick pick‑up | Check the bakery section of stores like **Walmart**, **Kroger**, **Safeway**, or **Whole Foods**. Some offer online ordering for pickup. | Good for last‑minute needs; limited customization. |
| **Subscription services** | Monthly cake deliveries (e.g., **Baker’s Dozen**, **Cake of the Month Club**) | Sign up on their websites. | Ideal if you love trying new flavors regularly. |
| **DIY cake kits** | Build‑your‑own cake at home | Order kits from **Amazon**, **Etsy**, or specialty kitchen stores. | Fun for parties or gifts; you get the cake and the experience. |

### Quick Steps to Order Online

1. **Choose a platform** (e.g., Goldbelly, local bakery website).
2. **Select your cake** – size, flavor, design, and any custom text.
3. **Add to cart** – specify delivery address and time window.
4. **Pay** – most sites accept credit cards, PayPal, or Apple Pay.
5. **Confirm** – you’ll receive an email confirmation and tracking info.

### If You’re in a Specific City

Let me know your city or zip code, and I can pull up a list of top-rated bakeries and delivery options right in your area!
